faq.question: Can I apply to every scholarship listed here with one application?
faq.answer: No—these are separate programs, not one combined USA application. You can use the catalog to explore options, but each listing has its own official process, requirements, and deadline.

faq.question: What should I compare before I apply?
faq.answer: Check who the scholarship is for, the study level, the field of study, the award amount, and the deadline for each row. In this slice, topics and examples span areas like Arts, Community, Education, and STEM, so fit can vary a lot by listing.

faq.question: Are the awards all the same size on this page?
faq.answer: No—amounts vary by listing and should be confirmed on official pages. In this filtered set, the visible rows show awards in the low-thousands, but you should compare each program individually before you apply.
